mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poi (street_area_id, name, poi_type, store_id, longitude, latitude, description, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{streetAreaId}, #{name}, #{poiType}, #{storeId}, #{longitude}, #{latitude}, #{description}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE poi SET name=#{name}, poi_type=#{poiType}, store_id=#{storeId}, longitude=#{longitude}, latitude=#{latitude}, description=#{description}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, street_area_id, name, poi_type, store_id, longitude, latitude, description, status, created_at, updated_at FROM poi WHERE id=#{id}
